scope: 50 concrete startup CPU/working-set targets: four imports and 46 shell color bindings, addressed through five shared production changes.
ranking: Import page-in opportunities first; direct bindings ordered by palette repetition, then shared card backgrounds/borders. Engineering priority order, not a measured per-target savings ranking.
limits: WaitForInputIdle can precede shell construction. Brush changes may improve visible-ready CPU/memory without changing first idle; WinUI may independently load graphics DLLs. No working-set trimming or benchmark delays.
